Five 2020-2024 annual Los Angeles County sensitivities multiply the exact December county ZORI year-over-year change by the same-ending-year structural lower and upper exposure bounds without monthly carry-forward. why_hard_from_docx: Clean completions data not consistently public at county level
best_public_workaround_from_docx: Use separately labeled Central and Slow distributed-lag scenarios from 5+ unit permits, with the approved bucket weights and complete-lag missingness rules.
limitation: Central distributes 20% of each 5+ permit cohort equally over lags 12-17, 55% over lags 18-23, and 25% over lags 24-30; Slow distributes 20% over lags 18-23, 50% over lags 24-29, and 30% over lags 30-36. Central has 288 and Slow 282 non-null LA County months. Every required lag must be present, missing permits are never zero-filled, and there is no unsuffixed best estimate. These are panel-derived scenario fields exposed in the county panel and renter view; they are intentionally not materialized as native rows in analytics.fact_housing_observation.

limitation: Each scenario follows prior stock + current 5+ permits - scenario completions. Opening stock includes every permit cohort with positive uncompleted weight in a complete 30-month Central or 36-month Slow active window rather than starting at zero. Central has 289 and Slow 283 non-null LA County months; missing active-window inputs propagate to null and no unsuffixed best estimate is emitted. These are panel-derived scenario fields exposed in the county panel and renter view; they are intentionally not materialized as native rows in analytics.fact_housing_observation.
